premises.text: Venmo makes it easy and fun to pay and charge friends by linking a credit card and bank account to the phone
premises.evidence_span: Venmo is a service that makes it really easy and really fun to pay and charge your friends. You get to link a credit card and a bank account to your phone

premises.text: Giphy is an iPhone app that lets people hide real money at real-world locations for friends to find by checking in through Foursquare
premises.evidence_span: Giphy is an iPhone application that lets people hide real money at real-world locations for their friends to find by checking in through Foursquare

premises.text: Friends do not need the Giphy app to receive a gift; Foursquare friendship plus Venmo delivery is enough
premises.evidence_span: your friends don't need to have the application to receive a gift from you. So all they need to do is be Foursquare friends with you, and Venmo is going to handle the rest

premises.text: Venmo social transactions complement the location check-in interactions that take place on Foursquare
premises.evidence_span: these social transactions that seem to fit really well and actually complement the types of interactions that take place on Foursquare

value.text: Make someone feel special by leaving real money gifts at places for friends to find
value.evidence_span: It really does feel nice to make someone feel special

secondary_value.text: Businesses and brands can use Giphy to show loyalty, service, and hospitality to customers and their friends
secondary_value.evidence_span: What a great way for businesses to show their customers, and more importantly, their customers' friends, about how they think about loyalty, service, and hospitality

causal_links.evidence_span: makes it really easy and really fun to pay and charge your friends
hide real money at real-world locations for their friends to find by checking in
